title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência prática com AWS e suas principais ferramentas;
  • Conhecimento em RabbitMQ ou tecnologias similares de mensageria;
  • Domínio de arquitetura de microsserviços ;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) ;
  • Desejavel Experiência com MongoDB ou outros bancos NoSQL ;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com times ágeis, CI/CD e versionamento com Git .


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Roteirista Redes Sociais (Finanças e Economia)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Roteirista de Redes Sociais (Finanças/Economia) para integrar nosso time na VAROS.


A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educacional. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Roteirista, você será responsável por pensar e criar os roteiros de vídeos curtos e longos sobre finanças, economia, investimento e geopolítica que serão usados nos vídeos divulgados nas redes sociais da VAROS e de seus sócios.

Responsabilidades

  • Escolha de temas e elaboração de cronograma para vídeos de finanças, economia, geopolítica e investimentos no Instagram e Youtube;

Isso inclui revisar cortes preliminares, sugerir ajustes de ritmo, validar escolhas de gráficos e b-rolls e estar disponível pra tirar dúvidas do editor sobre intenção e timing.

  • Graduação em Jornalismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou Engenharia;

  • Portfólio com roteiros publicados;


Hard Skills

  • Domínio sólido dos fundamentos de mercado financeiro brasileiro: renda fixa, renda variável, macroeconomia, leitura de balanços e indicadores econômicos.
  • Excelente habilidade de escrita;

Ferramentas

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.

title: \"Salesforce Analyst #997821\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender uma das maiores empresas globais do setor de energia, com forte atuação em inovação, tecnologia e transformação digital. O profissional atuará em iniciativas estratégicas voltadas para marketing digital, automação e experiência do cliente , em um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Ser referência técnica de Salesforce dentro das equipes.
  • Desenvolver e integrar soluções em Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Pardot (Account Engagement), Commerce Cloud e Experience Cloud .
  • Apoiar metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe ) na execução dos projetos.
  • Criar e consumir APIs para integração com Salesforce e Azure .
  • Gerenciar versionamento de código com GitHub e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions ).
  • Produzir documentação técnica clara.
  • Coletar requisitos com stakeholders e validar entregáveis.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência com Journey Builder e Automation Studio
  • Conhecimento em SQL e AMPscript
  • Experiência com integrações via API
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (mandatório)

  • Noções de Git/GitHub ou CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em HTML, CSS ou JavaScript para personalização de campanhas
  • Perfil proativo, com boa comunicação e autonomia


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.


Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.


Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.


Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.


Your challenges will include:

  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.

  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;
  • Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;
  • Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;
  • Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;
  • Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;
  • Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.



Quem procuramos


Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:


  • Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;
  • Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;
  • Habilidade para construir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;
  • Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório.
  • Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;
  • Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;
  • Graduação completa;
  • Inglês avançado.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade


Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.


Faça parte da nossa história


Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Sitecore Engineering Manager
description:
Digital Experience Engineering Manager

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract


Description:

Step into a pivotal leadership role as a Digital Experience Engineering Manager, where you'll guide a team of talented Sitecore developers and web technology experts to deliver innovative and scalable digital solutions. Your influence will shape the future of our web platforms, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and security. In this dynamic position, you'll have the opportunity to drive technological excellence, mentor a high-performing team, and play a key role in transforming business goals into cutting-edge digital experiences. If you are passionate about leading teams, driving innovation, and making a tangible impact, we invite you to lead with us and propel our digital capabilities to new heights.

If you are excited to make a difference applying cutting-edge technologies to solve real business challenges and add value to a global, market-leading organization, please come join us!


Key Interfaces:

Internal: NA Marketing VP, NA Marketing Brands and Product Teams, NA D&A Product Managers; Legal Team, DTS Cloud Team; DTS Enterprise Architecture Team; NA DTS Team.

External: Marketing Agencies, Third Party Providers.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and web technology professionals, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of high-quality, scalable web solutions that align with business strategies and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with UX/UI designers, product managers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and delivery of web projects.
  • Implement and enforce best practices in software development, including code quality, performance optimization, and security measures.
  • Drive the adoption of modern technologies and methodologies to enhance the team's capabilities and deliver innovative solutions.
  • Manage timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring that all initiatives are completed on time and within scope.
  • Lead the strategy for web and digital technology, aligning with organizational goals and driving digital transformation.
  • Stay current with emerging technology trends and integrate relevant advancements into the team's work.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging the team to stay ahead of industry trends and technological advancements.
  • Ensure that all development and web solutions comply with relevant data privacy regulations such as CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other global privacy standards.
  • Implement mechanisms for handling user consent, managing data access controls, and ensuring that all data collection practices align with legal requirements.
  • Act as a point of escalation for technical issues, providing solutions and guiding the team through complex challenges.
  • Collaborate with other engineering managers and leaders to align on technical strategies and share best practices.
  • Report on progress, team performance, and technological advancements to senior leadership.
  • Lead the team's efforts in troubleshooting and resolving issues, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines.


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in information technology leading remote, global teams across time zones and a minimum of 5 years of experience in product or engineering management.
  • 8+ years of experience and deep understanding of digital marketing technologies is required, specifically in web development.
  • Strong expertise in Sitecore CMS and other web technologies with experience in building, delivering, and operating digital platforms
  • Technical leadership experience with solution architecture, software development, engineering management, and application delivery, including CICD, SDLC, and MACH architecture practices
  • Proven track record in leading and delivering complex digital projects.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a team.
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and project management tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations like CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and their implications for web development.
  • Experience implementing data protection mechanisms, including consent management, data encryption, and access controls.
  • Familiarity with One Trust or similar systems privacy and compliance features, including the ability to configure and enforce data protection settings.
  • Proven ability and experience in building highly skilled product teams and mentoring a team of developers.
  • Strong sense of urgency in delivering results and high cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Operate as a change agent at multiple levels of an organization with outstanding organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration at all levels.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills

title: Coordenador de Operações
description:
Sobre a Empresa



Estamos buscando um Coordenador de Operação & Manutenção (O&M) com vivência sólida em usinas termoelétricas com motores a combustão, capaz de atuar desde a fase de implantação/construção, apoiando engenharia e obra com a visão de operação, até a entrada em operação comercial e a rotina de O&M.



Sobre a Função



Posição estratégica: o profissional será o ponto de integração entre engenharia, comissionamento, fornecedores / contratistas e operação, garantindo que a planta seja entregue com confiabilidade, desempenho, segurança e conformidade técnica / documental.



Responsabilidades



  • Representar a operação durante a fase de implantação: antecipar riscos operacionais e garantir “operabilidade” do projeto.
  • Planejar e coordenar o comissionamento, testes e partida (sistemas elétricos, mecânicos, utilidades, automação / SCADA e integração).
  • Supervisionar testes de desempenho e validações pré-operação, assegurando aderência a requisitos técnicos e normativos.
  • Coordenar interface com fornecedores e empreiteiras, acompanhando cronograma, qualidade e marcos de entrega.
  • Consolidar e cobrar documentação técnica (procedimentos, as-built, manuais, planos de manutenção, listas de sobressalentes).
  • Apoiar a estruturação da operação: rotinas, indicadores, planos de manutenção, gestão de falhas e confiabilidade.



Qualificações



  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica (ou correlatas).



Habilidades Necessárias



  • Experiência comprovada em O&M e comissionamento em geração de energia em termelétrica.
  • Forte capacidade de coordenação técnica, liderança e interface com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Perfil “mão na massa”, com presença em campo e foco em entrega.



Habilidades Preferenciais



  • Experiência em implantação / greenfield, comissionamento e start-up de usinas.
  • Especialização / MBA em Gestão de Projetos.
  • Inglês técnico / avançado.



Faixa Salarial e Pacote de Compensação



Remuneração compatível com o mercado + benefícios (a definir conforme modelo de contratação).



Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades



Projeto relevante, com alto nível de responsabilidade e visibilidade. Ambiente dinâmico, com espaço real para construir processos e formar time.
